title: Tic Tac Toe
shortDescription: 2-player grid board with win-state detection, turn indicators, and match resets.

spec.tagline: Two-player turn-based board challenge with automatic victory checking.
spec.summary: A sleek, responsive Tic Tac Toe browser game for two players. Featuring dynamic turn indicators, grid cell interactions, winning condition evaluation, and match stats persisted in LocalStorage.
spec.targetAudience: Students and casual players looking for a clean, zero-dependency browser game.

primaryFeatures.name: 3x3 Interactive Grid
primaryFeatures.description: Responsive grid cells with click interactions and distinct X/O visual indicators.

primaryFeatures.name: Victory & Draw Resolution
primaryFeatures.description: Instant win line highlighting for rows, columns, and diagonals, or tie game detection.

primaryFeatures.name: Match Statistics Counter
primaryFeatures.description: Tracks total X wins, O wins, and draws in browser LocalStorage across rounds.

steps: Player X clicks any empty grid cell.
Board marks 'X' and turn indicator updates to Player O.
Players alternate until a line forms or all 9 cells fill.
Winning player is announced and stats counter increments.

architectureHighlights: CSS Grid layout with aspect-ratio squares for responsive boards
Array-based 9-cell board state evaluation against 8 winning combinations
Event-driven state mutation with LocalStorage sync
assumptions: Local pass-and-play multiplayer on the same browser screen
No external server required; all statistics stored in localStorage

modules.title: Build 3x3 Grid Board Layout
modules.learningObjective: Use CSS Grid to create a responsive 3x3 board containing 9 cell button elements with data-index attributes.
modules.lesson:
# CSS Grid for Board Layouts

`grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr)` provides an ideal structure for a 3x3 game board.
modules.task: Add `<main class="board-container">` with `<div id="game-board" class="game-board">` containing 9 `<button class="cell" data-index="0"></button>` through `data-index="8"`.

solutionFiles.content: Tic Tac Toe

.game-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 0.5rem; margin: 1rem auto; max-width: 300px; }
.cell { background: #090d16; border: 2px solid #233150; border-radius: 0.5rem; aspect-ratio: 1; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; }

modules.learningObjective: Implement JavaScript arrays to evaluate board state against winning combinations and persist match statistics.
modules.lesson:
# Evaluating Game Combinations

There are 8 possible win combinations in Tic Tac Toe: 3 rows, 3 columns, and 2 diagonals. On every click, we update the array and check for a winner.
modules.task: Link `<script src="app.js"></script>`. In `app.js`, add click handlers to grid cells, alternate between 'X' and 'O', detect victory/tie conditions, and persist stats to `localStorage`.
